blocks.text: Healthcare operations, with technology behind them

Purview Healthcare is the operations arm of the group’s Healthcare and Life Sciences vertical, working alongside iPhysicianHub. Its billing teams use Purview-built automation and AI for coding support, claim scrubbing and denial analytics, which is why it can offer practice-level service at scale.
